title: SIAPSO voice evaluation manifest
description: One entry per consented volunteer recording of a medicine or remedy name. The consent record itself is kept outside the repository.

file.description: Path of the 16-bit WAV file, relative to eval/speech/audio/. No parent folder, no drive letter, forward slashes only.

text.description: Reference transcription, exactly what the speaker says.

lang.description: Language spoken: French, Wolof, or both in the same utterance.

expect.description: Id of the product or plant the resolver should return (optional; used for name accuracy).

speaker.description: Pseudonymous speaker id, never a name.

consent.description: Reference of the consent record, which is kept outside the repository.

licence.description: Licence the speaker agreed to for publication of the recording.
